text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S's challenge in the Twinkle Series. Three years of continually stacking up "results" have come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, her 'mission' will remain unchanged,
continuing far into the future."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as "trials" are bestowed upon every Umamusume...
and a "revolution" continues to stir within their souls—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"—Heartiest congratulations on being awarded
the 'URA Umamusume of the Year'!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In recognition of her outstanding performance,
Symboli Kris S was chosen as Horse Girl of the Year...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While accompanying her to the award ceremony as her Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, a special guest will present
Symboli Kris S with a commemorative gift
and a bouquet of flowers!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...A special guest?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to what I'd heard beforehand,
Symboli Rudolf was supposed to take the stage here, but—

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
—Congratulations, Kris S.
...You've truly grown into someone magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Master――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The person who appeared was the mentor who taught Symboli Kris S the fundamentals of running and self-management before she came to Japan. It was the one she called "Master"...!

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kris S. You—
showed results in this country that went
far beyond my imagination, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I never... could have done this――
all by myself……――"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because...
there was someone who shared my "mission" with me.

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It seems you've found a partner in this country
who understands you and pushes you to grow together.

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text: And you... will not only bring a "revolution" to Japan's racing world, but—

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
You've grown into someone who represents all Japanese Umamusume.
As someone who was part of your journey, even for a short time... I couldn't be prouder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Me... representing Japan...?

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
Once again—congratulations on Horse of the Year.
And thank you, Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, despite a few surprises, the Umamusume of the Year awards ceremony concluded without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—Named Umamusume of the Year,
Symboli Kris S! Attention around her
continues to grow each day, both at home and abroad!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Her overwhelming performance at last year's Arima Kinen
left a deep impression on many—today, we hit the streets
to ask the public about Kris S!"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople A
text_block_list.text: "Honestly, I wasn't really rooting for her at first. She was kind of aloof, and she suddenly started talking about a 'revolution' and all..."

text_block_list.name: Townspeople A
text_block_list.text: "Yet, you steadily kept delivering results in races... and at the Arima Kinen, I realized you'd been thinking about Japan this whole time—"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople A
text_block_list.text:
"...I felt so terribly sorry.
And at the same time, I thought she was so cool—
so—"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople A
text_block_list.text: "I believe Symboli Kris S is without a doubt an Umamusume who carries Japan on her shoulders and represents our nation today. ...Good luck! And thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople B
text_block_list.text:
"‘I mean, she's always been strong, right?!
And even when she wins, she's totally cool about it!
I used to have another favorite, but—’"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople B
text_block_list.text:
"She's lost to Kris S a good number of times!
Sometimes I'm like, 'How can you stay so calm
after beating my fave?!'—"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople B
text_block_list.text: "Still, my favorite girl kept trying her absolute hardest to beat Kris S... and she just kept getting cooler and cooler~! And then—"

text_block_list.name: Townspeople B
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, I realized it's all because Symboli Kris S
has stayed so strong all this time.
And once that thought crossed my mind—""

text_block_list.name: Townspeople B
text_block_list.text: "I finally realized that today's Japanese racing scene was hyped up by Kris S! ...Thank you! Symboli Kris S!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Lately, the media had been
flooded with praise celebrating
Symboli Kris S's achievements up to this point...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I never even considered it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I came to this country... to fulfill my "duty"—.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Strictly speaking... I was merely that kind of existence...—
Being accepted by everyone in Japan—
...was something I had never even dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, everyone—even Master...—
They all...—"
choice_data_list: Something like this is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've watched her from the closest distance, for the longest time.
I know how she has kept running all this time for the sake of the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And as a 'result' of that, she became Horse Girl of the Year.
There's no way she doesn't represent Japan now!"
choice_data_list: So it's okay to be happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's... really okay for me to be happy, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I'm so... happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the kindling of countless "revolutions,"
Symboli Kris S, and the future, keep running on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――From here on out lies a path unknown, never before seen—the path of Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I will continue to walk that path alongside her—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's finally starting.
choice_data_list: Are you getting nervous after all?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No.
――It's the same as always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Otherwise—...it'd be disrespectful to that guy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The races and opponents waiting ahead are surely—
looking forward to facing the current Symboli Kris S more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And I, too, am here—
looking forward to this confrontation more than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Today's race will surely be—for me—
a major turning point—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet—
even if that is the case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Be with me.
...I want you to walk alongside me, now and always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: As my—partner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if this marks an end...
The "mission" shared between me and Symboli Kris S
will never truly end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as... races exist in this world.
As long as there are Umamusume with burning souls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "ordeal" continues to exist.
Unchanging, forever—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It's the same, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —The time has come.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...You and I are each other's destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Entwining the chains of destiny, sharing their weight,
and echoing together—a one-and-only existence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Which is precisely why, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning—
your words, to me, were—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ......Still, don't you think that's a bit boring, Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for a predetermined script.
Chaos is sublime precisely because no one can dictate it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, only by destroying everything
that was promised to the world—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —The future will be forged.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I know.
That is... our 'revolution.' Yours, and mine.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh, hahahahaha!!
BAHAHAHAHAHA!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, Kris S... What a sinner you are.
To think you would drag me out from the shadows—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, deep within my chest—
'Defeat you!' it cries!
'Carve my name into this world once more!!'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: For she kindled such a "flame"—and shattered fate beyond all recognition!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Is this the "answer"?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it.
You know it, right? That part comes next.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's begin, Kris S!
Defying destiny, rebelling, and forging—
this race of an unknown future, unseen by anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Naturally, the one who will win is—

text_block_list.name: Fated Pair
text_block_list.text:
It's me.
It's me.
